qualification: Startup to the main menu on this PC after moving the complete export to a short local path, with all files of the original Base directory inaccessible through exclusive read-only handles. Existing OS prerequisites and registry entries were retained.
environment_note: The first restricted test process could not access loopback (WinError 10013). An excessively nested test path also exceeded the unchanged native storage-path guard and exited before the menu. The successful normal-rights run used a short local path and changed no firewall or OS security settings.
edition: Previously authorized private Steam-data copy with unchanged owned Ubisoft startup basis
